hypothesis: Averaging independently seeded copies of the frozen v206 full-order LambdaRank component will reduce estimator variance and improve trifecta log loss without changing features, labels, temperature, or blend weight.

method.probability_ensemble: arithmetic mean after each seed score is converted by Plackett-Luce

interpretation: Passing creates a variance-reduced challenger only. It does not erase the known full-order-label selection bias or replace a clean frozen future test.
